name: Checkers
tagline: Jump the other side. Crown a king. Play the computer, or a friend on the other side.
description:
A ten-by-ten board. White and black take turns. Men step one square forward on the diagonal. You must jump when you can, and a jump can chain. Reach the far side and the man becomes a king, who may go any way. Take all of the other side, or leave them with nowhere to go, and you win. White goes first.

On your own you play a computer that thinks on this device. There is no game server. Pass the phone for two people in the same room, or press Play a friend and send the invite: the same board, live, on two devices. White sits one side, black the other. Tap a piece, then tap where it goes.

An unofficial port of Checkers by stroibot. The computer is the same one that shipped with that game.
